# Banner

A persistent page-level message under the page header about a condition that affects the whole page, with at most one action and, for non-critical messages, a…

`SongNodes.Banner` · Feedback

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.Banner status="info" title="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.Banner" status="info" title="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (BannerProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` * | `"info" \| "warn" \| "bad" \| "ok"` | info / warn / bad / ok. |
| `title` * | `string` | Bold lead sentence: "Sets are shaped on energy alone." |
| `text` | `ReactNode` | Supporting sentence with numbers: "Only 611 of 1,284 tracks have a key and BPM so far." |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` | One or two actions (secondary buttons or a module button). |
| `onDismiss` | `() => void` | Dismiss handler; not allowed for status "bad". Dismissal is remembered per person. |
| `page` | `boolean` | Full-bleed under the page header (no side borders or radius). |
